title: Unlimited shortcuts on your New Tab
caption: Group them, give them emoji or colours, and open a whole group in one click.

title: Type a name, press Enter
caption: The search box finds your shortcuts as you type. Enter opens the match; one arrow key away is a web search.

title: Bring your bookmarks along
caption: Pick a bookmarks folder and it becomes a group of shortcuts. Ones you already have are skipped.

title: Deleted the wrong one? Undo
caption: Shortcuts and groups come back exactly where they were. Layout changes undo with Ctrl+Z.

title: Place every tile where you want it
caption: Free placement with smart guides, align and distribute tools, resizing, and undo for every move.
